headline.en: Rodri trained in the gym, away from the main group
headline.es: Rodri trabajo en el gimnasio, fuera del grupo

summary.en: SPORT reported that Rodri trained on his own again on Saturday and did gym work. The club set that plan when he arrived after the World Cup. He played a few minutes against Athletic Club. Those minutes were his first appearance, not a full return to the midfield.
summary.es: SPORT dijo que Rodri volvio a trabajar al margen el sabado. Los minutos ante el Athletic fueron su primera aparicion, no una vuelta completa.

body.en:
Rodri joined Barcelona after the World Cup and was put on a separate training plan so the load would rise slowly. SPORT reported from the Ciutat Esportiva that he trained apart again on Saturday and used the gym. He came on against Athletic Club in a 2-0 win, with the match already going Barcelona's way.

Pedri is starting in midfield. Gavi missed Saturday after the knock at Elche. Flick can use Rodri in short bursts. Starting him against Rayo and again in the first European week would jump the plan the club set when he arrived. There is no new injury bulletin. There is also no indication he starts on Monday.

tweets.name: Diario SPORT
tweets.text: Rodri continua con su plan especifico. Volvio a entrenarse al margen del grupo.

tweets.name: Pol Ballus
tweets.text: Limited minutes for Rodri this week. The gym plan is still on.

tweets.name: BarcaFutbolLive
tweets.text: Cameo against Athletic. Saturday he was back in individual work.

headline.en: Atletico will not sell Julian Alvarez to Barcelona
headline.es: El Atletico no vendera a Julian Alvarez al Barca

summary.en: Atletico Madrid still will not negotiate Julian Alvarez. Ramon Fuentes wrote in Mundo Deportivo that decree 1006 would not automatically punish a forced exit. That is a legal note, not an offer. Flick is using Raphinha and Ferran Torres as the reference in attack.
summary.es: El Atletico no negocia a Alvarez. Fuentes escribio sobre el decreto 1006. No hay oferta. Flick sigue con Raphinha y Ferran.

body.en:
Atletico Madrid have not opened talks on Julian Alvarez. Flick, Deco and Laporta have already said they will not chase a striker Atletico will not sell. Ramon Fuentes wrote in Mundo Deportivo that Spanish decree 1006 would not automatically sanction Alvarez or Barcelona if he tried to leave. That is a lawyer's reading of a rule. It is not a bid and Atletico have not confirmed any clause talk involving Arsenal.

Barcelona have started the Liga season without a classic centre-forward. Raphinha and Ferran Torres are the players Flick is using high up the pitch. Until Atletico change their position there is no Alvarez transfer to write. The team is already playing without him.

tweets.name: BarcaFutbolLive
tweets.text: No talks. No bid. Raphinha and Ferran are the reference for now.

headline.en: Barcelona play Rayo on Monday at 21:30. Gavi missed Saturday training
headline.es: El Barca juega contra el Rayo el lunes a las 21:30. Gavi no entrenó el sabado

summary.en: Barcelona host Rayo Vallecano on Monday at 21:30. Mundo Deportivo said Livakovic was in Saturday's session and Gavi was not, after the knock at Elche. Pedri has already covered that midfield role. Barcelona have two wins from two.
summary.es: El Barca recibe al Rayo el lunes a las 21:30. Livakovic si estuvo el sabado. Gavi no. Pedri ya cubrio ese puesto.

body.en:
Rayo Vallecano visit Camp Nou on Monday at 21:30, Barcelona's first midweek Liga match of the season. Mundo Deportivo reported that Livakovic trained with the group on Saturday and Gavi did not. Gavi left the Elche match with a knee problem. Flick said the first reading was not as serious as it looked. Pedri started against Athletic and can start again. Rodri is still on a gym plan.

Rayo usually defend deep and attack the space behind the full-backs, which is a different game to Elche and Athletic. Barcelona have scored seven and conceded none. Squad news closer to kickoff will confirm whether Gavi is in the group.
